Haryana Extends Verification Deadline for Contractual Employees

The Haryana government, led by Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini, has extended the deadline for the verification process for contractual employees. This decision is presented as a relief for these employees. Separately, the state government also revised rules concerning sports graduation certificates for athletes, specifically impacting state-level competitions.
